title: Privacy Policy & Cookie Usage
intro: Welcome to ranzakOS! Before proceeding, please read how we handle your data and cookies on this website.
section1Text: ranzakOS is a web-based portfolio operating system simulator meant for personal presentation and interactive experiences. It runs entirely inside your browser.
section2Text: To maintain state and settings, this site heavily relies on LocalStorage and Cookies. We DO NOT use them for tracking, advertising, or sharing with third parties. We store the following data locally in your browser:
section3Text: Cookies: os_locale (Language), os-theme, os-wallpaper, os-accent-color (Theme), os-taskbar-pos, os-desktop-icons (UI layout), browser_history (Browser history), ranzakos_license, ranzakos_privacy_version (License and terms version). Local Storage: os-music-volume (Volume), custom wallpaper data.
section4Text: We do not collect personal identifiable data (PII). All sessions, customizations, and history stay exclusively on your local machine. We may use basic analytics for site traffic, but it is fully anonymized.
